# betterado_check_branch_control (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

data "betterado_environment" "example" {
  name       = "ExampleEnvironment"
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
}

resource "betterado_check_branch_control" "example" {
  project_id           = data.betterado_project.example.id
  target_resource_id   = data.betterado_environment.example.id
  target_resource_type = "environment"
  display_name         = "Branch Control Check"
  allowed_branches     = "refs/heads/main, refs/heads/release/*"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `target_resource_id` (String)
- `target_resource_type` (String)

### Optional

- `allowed_branches` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `ignore_unknown_protection_status` (Boolean)
- `timeout` (Number)
- `verify_branch_protection` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `version` (Number)
